summary: Screen component that acts as the outer most container providing the background color. (Package docs; Coin has no designer guide for Screen.)

examples.purpose: A screen's outermost container holding the page flow.
examples.jsx:
<Screen modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}>
  <VStack modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}>
    <Title title="Personal loan" modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }} />
  </VStack>
</Screen>

props.name: children
props.description: The content to display inside the screen.

props.name: modes
props.description: Modes object to override default variable values.

props.name: style
props.description: Optional style overrides for the container.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: A token collection Screen reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.
